metadata.name: fmt2-kolla-deployer-vm
metadata.description: Define and bootstrap the Rocky Linux 10 Kolla-Ansible deployer VM on kvm-sfo200-ter-9924 dstore storage without touching pri/sec OpenStack nodes.

variables.name: ter_host
variables.description: FMT2 R630 storage/provisioning anchor that owns dstore and the dstore-images libvirt pool.

variables.name: deployer_vm
variables.description: Rocky Linux 10 deployer VM that will run Kolla-Ansible.

variables.name: deployer_ip
variables.description: FMT2 management IP reserved for the deployer VM.

variables.name: deployer_storage_dataset
variables.description: ZFS dataset on ter that backs portable libvirt deployer VM images. Validate with: zfs list dstore/libvirt/images.

variables.name: deployer_storage_path
variables.description: Mounted path for dstore-images; do not write deployer VM disks to the OS RAID1 mirror.

variables.name: kolla_release
variables.description: Pinned Kolla-Ansible/OpenStack release stream for the FMT2 pilot. The default virtualenv path is /opt/kolla-ansible-2026.1.

variables.name: kolla_ansible_package_spec
variables.description: Pinned pip package selector for the deployer virtualenv.

stages.summary: Verify ter dstore storage and libvirt pool are available before any deployer VM disk is created.
command: sudo virsh pool-info dstore-images && sudo zfs list ${deployer_storage_dataset} && test -d ${deployer_storage_path}

stages.summary: Render the intended deployer VM definition and package set without creating the VM.
command: printf '%s\n' 'deployer_vm=${deployer_vm}' 'deployer_ip=${deployer_ip}' 'host=${ter_host}' 'storage=${deployer_storage_dataset}' 'path=${deployer_storage_path}' 'os=${deployer_os}' 'packages=python3 python3-pip python3-devel python3-venv gcc libffi-devel openssl-devel podman git' 'kolla.container_engine=podman' 'kolla.base_distro=rocky' 'kolla.openstack_release=${kolla_release}' 'kolla.package_spec=${kolla_ansible_package_spec}' 'safety=do not write deployer VM disks to the OS RAID1 mirror'

stages.summary: After human approval, create or validate the Rocky Linux 10 deployer VM on ter-backed dstore storage.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Approved execution command placeholder: create ${deployer_vm} as Rocky Linux 10 at ${deployer_ip} on ${ter_host}:${deployer_storage_path}. Verify VM disk path stays under ${deployer_storage_path}; verify SSH reaches ${deployer_vm}; verify sudo works; verify podman installs from Rocky 10 repos.'

stages.summary: Install Kolla-Ansible into a pinned virtualenv on the deployer VM.
Create /etc/kolla and seed globals.yml/passwords.yml examples from the Kolla-Ansible virtualenv.
command: sudo mkdir -p /etc/kolla && sudo cp -r /opt/kolla-ansible-${kolla_release}/share/kolla-ansible/etc_examples/kolla/* /etc/kolla/ && test -f /etc/kolla/globals.yml && test -f /etc/kolla/passwords.yml
